nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous on $[0, 1]$. Then there is a twice continuously differentiable function $u : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ with $u(0) = u(1) = 0$ and $u''(x) = f(x)$ for every $x \in (0, 1)$.
nodes.title: Existence for the one-dimensional Dirichlet problem

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be any function, and let $u_1, u_2 : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be twice continuously differentiable functions such that, for $i = 1, 2$, $u_i(0) = u_i(1) = 0$ and $u_i''(x) = f(x)$ for every $x \in (0, 1)$. Then $u_1(x) = u_2(x)$ for every $x \in [0, 1]$.
nodes.title: Uniqueness for the one-dimensional Dirichlet problem

nodes.summary: Let $V$ and $f$ be continuous real functions on $[0, 1]$ with $V \ge 0$. Then there is a function $u \colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ that is $C^2$ on $[0, 1]$, satisfies $-u''(x) + V(x)\,u(x) = f(x)$ for every $x \in [0, 1]$, with the second derivative taken within $[0, 1]$, and has $u(0) = u(1) = 0$.
nodes.title: Existence for the Sturm–Liouville Dirichlet problem on the closed unit interval

nodes.summary: Let $V$ and $f$ be continuous real functions on $[0, 1]$ with $V \ge 0$, and let $u_1, u_2 \colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be $C^2$ on $[0, 1]$. Suppose that for $i = 1, 2$, $-u_i''(x) + V(x)\,u_i(x) = f(x)$ for every $x \in [0, 1]$, with the second derivative taken within $[0, 1]$, and $u_i(0) = u_i(1) = 0$. Then $u_1$ and $u_2$ agree on $[0, 1]$.
nodes.title: Uniqueness for the Sturm–Liouville Dirichlet problem on the closed unit interval

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
